description: This file is a Python script for a Frappe-based ERPNext project that updates bank account data by copying branch codes from Bank records to Bank Account records.

methods.name: execute()
methods.description: Main function to reload documents and update branch codes in bank accounts based on bank records.

calls: frappe.db.sql("""UPDATE `tabBank` b, `tabBank Account` ba SET ba.branch_code = b.branch_code WHERE ba.bank = b.name AND ifnull(b.branch_code, '') != '' AND ifnull(ba.branch_code, '') = ''""")
